title: dupatya rigidula
intro: Dupatya rigidula, commonly known as the desert lavender or wild lavender, is a flowering shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dupatya rigidula include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
